title: Synergistic InSe quantum dots–mesoporous Ta2O5 nanostructure for ultrasensitive electrochemical detection of antibiotics in environmental samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42402-42420
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06344B, Paper
Open Access

Chou-Yi Hsu, Yousry Sadoon Rasheed, Yasir Qasim Almajidi, Ali Kamil Kareem, Subbulakshmi Ganesan, Alok Kumar Mishra, T. Krithiga, Sanjeev Kumar, Wesam R. Kadhum, Shayan Amiri
InSe QD/Ta2O5-modified GCE enables ultrasensitive detection of antibiotics with an LOD of ∼2.6 × 10−11 M. Its mesoporous structure and high electrocatalytic activity ensure rapid response and excellent selectivity.
